jobs.title: Service Operations Manager
jobs.location: Reading, Berkshire, Berkshire · Portsmouth · Glasgow, Renfrewshire, Renfrewshire
jobs.description: Base Location: You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations Havant, Reading or Glasgow Salary: £59,800 - £89,800 + performance-related bonus and a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family. Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available The role The IT & OT Service Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the seamless integration and management of IT and Operational Technology (OT) services within the organisation delivered by the IT Outsource partner. This role ensures that both IT and OT services align with the strategic objectives and operational requirements of the business, delivering optimal performance, reliability, and security to maximise availability and ensure a seamless, positive user experience. The individual will act as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and external service providers, ensuring effective governance and operational oversight of the contractual performance of the Service Integrator. You will Service Integration and Management (SIAM) : Manage the operational integration of IT and OT services to current industry standard and relevant contractual agreements, ensuring cohesive and efficient operations across both domains. Outsourced and Third-Party Collaboration: Manage relationships with outsourced service providers, SSE teams and third-party partners to ensure delivery of contracted services and adherence to SLAs. Operational Oversight : Provide operational oversight of outsourced delivery partners, ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Major Incident Management : Support Major Incident Management, coordinating responses to incidents and ensuring timely resolution to minimise impact on business operations. You will be part of the Service Operations Duty Manager roster and on call to provide 24/7 support. IT Service Management (ITSM): Implement and maintain IT service management processes and frameworks, ensuring best practices are followed through close collaboration with Service Strategy and Service/Process Architecture. You have Understanding of both IT and OT operational environments, including how technology performance, resilience, and availability directly affect business continuity, safety, and operational outcomes. Familiarity with recognised industry standards and best practices for service operations and incident management, supporting consistent processes, effective governance, and continual service improvement. Familiarity with outsourcing and third-party service delivery models, including working with suppliers to manage performance, clarify ownership, and maintain service quality across end-to-end operations. Proficiency in ITIL principles and service management tools, with the ability to apply structured processes to incident, problem, change, request, and service performance management. Strong incident management skills, including experience acting as a key incident commander to coordinate resolver groups, manage communications, drive timely resolution, and reduce business impact during major incidents. About SSE SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030. Our Finance teams create value for all SSE business areas and play a key role in fulfilling our obligations as a FTSE100 UK-listed company. In a highly regulated and competitive environment, their experts keep us powering ahead by identifying efficiencies, providing advice and optimising our financial strategies. Flexible benefits to fit your life Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave. Work with an equal opportunity employer SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact the company careers page / 01738 275 846 to discuss how we can support you. We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry. Ready to apply? Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work. #LI-DB1 #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Individual Contributor)
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own the complete post-sales customer journey, including onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support throughout the product development and delivery process. Guide customers through complex workflows by explaining production processes, managing expectations, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and internal capabilities. Act as the main point of coordination between customers, design teams, and production or sourcing partners to keep projects progressing smoothly. Monitor account progress, identify risks and bottlenecks, and proactively resolve issues before they impact timelines or customer satisfaction. Provide consultative support during product development phases, offering guidance on specifications, materials, product feedback, and technical considerations when needed. Manage a portfolio of SMB and mid-market accounts, maintaining accurate account information, tracking milestones, and monitoring customer health metrics. Identify opportunities for account expansion, including repeat orders, new product opportunities, and additional solutions aligned with customer goals. Collect customer feedback and collaborate with internal teams to improve processes, products, and overall customer experience. Maintain strong customer relationships through clear communication, proactive engagement, and a customer-first approach. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client operations, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience managing customer relationships in e-commerce, manufacturing, technology platforms, or customized product environments is highly advantageous. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to customers with different levels of expertise. Excellent project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and priorities simultaneously. Proactive problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve operational challenges. Commercial awareness and confidence identifying growth opportunities, upselling opportunities, and solutions that create customer value. Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or similar tools to manage accounts, track activities, and maintain customer records. Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment with strong ownership, organization, and accountability. Startup mindset with adaptability, urgency, resilience, and willingness to take initiative. Experience with apparel development, product manufacturing, fabric sourcing, or custom production is considered a strong advantage. Comfortable working with international teams and distributed colleagues across different time zones. Benefits: Fully remote working environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Opportunity to join a global team and collaborate with colleagues across multiple regions. High level of ownership and autonomy in managing customer relationships and improving processes. Direct impact on customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth. Opportunity to work with innovative systems and technology-driven workflows. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Inclusive and collaborative culture focused on curiosity, excellence, and customer success. Support for professional growth within a fast-paced, international environment. Draft change requests and Statements of Work for small to medium complexity enhancements Demonstrate an understanding of revenue recognition and account measurements Internal Process Demonstrate competency in all internal processes & practices Support Continuous Improvement initiatives Provide mentorship to team members Stay up to date on industry and job-related trends and best practices, including reading relevant publications, articles, blogs, etc. Other duties as assigned Who We’re Looking For   Minimum 1- 3 years' experience in Marine Cargo Insurance, Logistics or Logistics Software Minimum 1-3 years' experience minimum in customer success related role, interfacing and working directly with customers. Drive account growth by identifying upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the existing client portfolio. Lead regular business reviews with customers to evaluate performance, discuss strategic objectives, and identify future opportunities. Develop relationships with strategic partners and support regional business development initiatives, including industry events, conferences, and customer visits. Proven ability to manage and grow enterprise customer relationships while achieving commercial objectives. Highly organized with strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Experience using CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, to manage customer interactions and sales pipelines. Willingness to travel as required to support customer relationships, partner engagement, and industry events. Benefits Fully remote working environment with flexibility to work from home. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. The Customer Success Management (CSM) team focuses on the themes of align, enable, and expand. We align with customers’ desired business outcomes, enable them on their existing use cases, and work with them to expand into additional use cases, ensuring ongoing and ever-improving customer return-on-investment. Additionally, our team serves as liaisons between the customer and the GitLab ecosystem, streamlining collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and others.  CSM handbook has a lot more information regarding the team and responsibilities. What you'll do Partner with our customers in taking what was established in the pre-sales command plan, and turning the customers desired positive business outcomes into actionable objectives Know the GitLab platform, our more common best practices, and use cases in order to guide the customer Understand the customer journey and be able to guide them on future adoption Act as the GitLab liaison for GitLab questions, issues, or escalations. Collaborate with GitLab Support, Product Management (i.e., roadmaps), or other teams as needed Own a book of assigned customers, with a focus on increasing adoption, ensuring retention and growth, and overall customer satisfaction Remain knowledgeable and up-to-date on GitLab releases What you'll bring Understanding of Git and typical branching strategies is a must for this role Knowledge of software development lifecycle and development pipeline Understanding of continuous integration, continuous deployment, DevSecOps & AI Prior experience in Customer Success or equivalent history of increasing satisfaction, adoption, and retention Experience partnering with customers to define and achieve business outcomes Familiarity working with customers of sizes relevant to the assigned  segment Exceptional verbal, written, organizational, presentation, and communications skills Detailed oriented and analytical Strong team player but self-starter Project management experience & skills Strong technical, analytic, and problem-solving skills Alignment with our  values , and willingness to work in accordance with those values Willingness to travel if needed and comply with the company’s  travel policy Fluent English   Remote-Global How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off  Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave   Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.   Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also  GitLab’s EEO Policy  and  EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires  accommodation , please let us know during the  recruiting process .

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist (Morning Schedule)
jobs.description: Accountabilities Deliver high-quality, personalized support to customers through email, phone, and other communication channels. Build strong customer relationships by understanding individual needs, preferences, and engagement patterns. Promote campaigns, tournaments, loyalty programs, and other customer engagement initiatives to increase participation and satisfaction. Conduct customer interviews and collect feedback to identify opportunities for improving products, services, and the overall user experience. Support retention initiatives by encouraging customer loyalty and helping users progress to higher-value customer segments. Handle customer objections professionally, resolve inquiries efficiently, and provide guidance throughout the customer journey. Assist customers with account verification and other administrative processes when required. Monitor and achieve individual performance targets and KPIs while maintaining high service standards. Stay up to date with product updates, new features, and internal processes to provide accurate and effective support. Requirements Fluent written and spoken English with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Previous experience in customer success, customer support, account management, or a similar customer-facing role. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and maintain positive customer relationships. Proven ability to handle customer objections, resolve issues, and deliver solutions in a professional and empathetic manner. Sales-oriented mindset with the ability to identify customer needs and promote relevant products or services. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Resilient, proactive, and customer-focused approach with strong problem-solving abilities. Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and products in a dynamic environment. Previous experience in the iGaming industry is considered an advantage. Availability to work a fixed morning schedule from 06:30 to 15:30 Kyiv time , Monday to Friday. Benefits Fully remote full-time position with the flexibility to work from Europe. Competitive compensation package based on experience and qualifications. 20 paid vacation days, public holidays, and paid sick leave. Comprehensive private health insurance, including mental health support. Monthly flexible benefits budget for hobbies, sports, wellness, or personal interests. Dedicated learning and development budget, including professional training, workshops, language courses, and access to educational resources. Collaborative, supportive, and values-driven work culture with clear career development opportunities. Regular team events, knowledge-sharing sessions, and opportunities to participate in company initiatives. Stable weekday morning schedule that supports work-life balance. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Meddbase, A Cority Company is UK’s leading online EHR SaaS solution, designed for healthcare professionals seeking a secure practice management and patient record system. It includes a full suite of healthcare management software features covering consultations, cross-organization scheduling, patient analysis, document management, electronic referrals, pathology and reporting. The system also offers a user-friendly patient portal, automated email and SMS appointment reminders, and a built-in telemedicine platform with mobile app. Primary Responsibilities: Develop and cultivate relationships with existing clients, as a Cority trusted advisor. Proactively sell Cority products within your client base. Participate in/lead quarterly business reviews with your clients Identify contacts for all product lines within your client base. Work on inbound requests from clients, i.e. adding new modules, users, upgrades. Conduct product demonstrations as requested. Provide quotes, amending agreements, and services quotes as needed (with assistance from Consulting group). Work with consulting group to uncover new sales opportunities. Maintain accurate client information in Salesforce. Travel as required to develop and maintain relationships with accounts, both client and business development partners. Execute and manage program for channel/strategic partners in assigned territories. Execute market research projects as assigned. Support European sales opportunities as required, both on-site and remotely. Conduct product demonstrations as requested (Microsoft Teams/Zoom and on-site). Attend industry trade exhibitions and conferences as requested. Cority software knowledge an asset Qualifications: Must have a university degree in business or equivalent work experience. Must have at least 3 years’ experience in sales, account management or business development. Must have the ability to work independently as well as on a team. Must possess strong organization and time management skills. Must feel confident demonstrating the Cority application. Must have excellent interpersonal skills. About Us Medical Management Systems is an ISO 27001:2013 certified organization that adheres to NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSP Toolkit) standards and GDPR compliance. As part of your role, you will be required to complete annual data security awareness training and follow company policies on secure information handling. We are an equal opportunities employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability status.
